dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: Traveler, what business do you have here? No outlanders are allowed to enter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the headquarters of the Tenryou Commission...

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: The headquarters of the Tenryou Commission is an important Shogunate facility. It maintains law and order across Inazuma, and executes every order from the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: As such, it is my duty to interrogate every person coming in and out. Those who cannot explain their identity and intentions shall not enter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you ever seen someone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: Hmm? An outlander? I have never seen one. We rarely have outlanders coming in. I would have remembered, had I seen one.

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: Please go to the Hanamizaka Police Station if you mean to lodge a report about a missing person.

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Glory to the Shogun and her everlasting reign! Please don't come back if you have no business here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you ever seen someone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: Hmm? An outlander? Nope. I mean, I would have remembered, had I seen one.

dialogues.speaker: Inoue
dialogues.text: Please go to the Hanamizaka Police Station if you mean to lodge a report about a missing person.
